answer: In this PoA design, each identity must complete a Wesolowski VDF: a long chain of dependent modular squarings whose next step cannot be computed before the previous one. GPUs can run separate chains in parallel, but cannot shorten one chain’s delay; cloning identities therefore multiplies hardware and energy costs rather than yielding instant, cheap Sybils. The nebula, ridge, and tundra may differ, but each identity faces the same sequential time bottleneck.
